title: OKF-YAML decision record
description: One decision record, authored as data. Every prose field of the generated markdown is a named key here. `additionalProperties` is false at every level, so a typo in a key is an error rather than a silently ignored field. Copy this into the adopting repo and tighten the patterns to its dialect.

id.description: Record identifier, ADR-NNNN. Fixed four-digit width so ids sort lexically.

plan_id.description: Optional external identifier: a planning-era id, a ticket, an upstream record. Null where none applies. Usable as the graph grouping key via --group-by plan_id.

group.description: Optional cluster label for the generated graph. Absent, the generator groups by the first tag.

description.description: One-line routing summary for the index and the OKF frontmatter. Must not end in a full stop: it is a label, not a sentence. Anchored to the end rather than banning '.', or any value containing a path such as '~/.config' would fail.

provenance.description: The evidence the decision rests on.

enforced_in.description: The surfaces where the decision is actually binding.

relates_to.description: Typed edges over a closed vocabulary. Every relation is paired with its inverse so a validator can check symmetry; a missing inverse is reported, never failed.

we_prefer.description: Must name the rejected alternative; the shape is 'X, over Y'.

unless.description: The escape hatch, or 'never' when the decision is unconditional.

cons.description: A record with no cons has not been thought about.
